title: Collecting every error
hints: Run each task in its own goroutine (wg.Add(1) before go) and store its error in errs[i], one slot per task, so no lock is needed.
After wg.Wait(), errors.Join(errs...) combines them. It skips nil errors and returns nil if every one is nil.
errs := make([]error, len(tasks)); for i, task := range tasks { wg.Add(1); go func() { defer wg.Done(); errs[i] = task() }() }; wg.Wait(); return errors.Join(errs...)
